preconditions.description: The input string length does not exceed 1000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(char) <= 126 for char in input_string)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string are printable ASCII characters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of palindromic substrings in the input string.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(len(input_string)) for j in range(i, len(input_string)) if input_string[i:j+1] == input_string[i:j+1][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of palindromic substrings in the input string, where each palindromic substring is counted exactly once.
